dedupe_keys.name: netmob26 dataset of public bus mobility in niteroi netmob 2026 data challenge

description: The NetMob26 dataset gives a multi-source view of public bus operations and passenger demand in the city of Niterói, Rio de Janeiro state, Brazil, for March 2026. It combines high-frequency GPS telemetry of the public bus fleet, about 7.2 million anonymised smart card boarding transactions with fare types and card categories, auxiliary data on lines, routes and stops, hourly weather (temperature, rainfall, wind) and socio-demographic indicators from the 2022 Brazilian census; records link through spatial and temporal references. It was released for the NetMob 2026 Data Challenge, whose conference takes place at the Institute of Computing of Fluminense Federal University in October 2026, and is described by Domingos and colleagues in an arXiv paper of May 2026. Coverage is city scale for one month, with CSV, JSON and GeoJSON files. Access is restricted: prospective users apply through a data request form, accept the challenge terms and conditions and sign a non-disclosure agreement; there is no fee, and example notebooks are public on GitHub. Caveats: passenger identifiers are anonymised, operational inconsistencies were removed in preprocessing, and access after the challenge is not stated. The data support network flow and capacity planning studies of bus services, demand forecasting, accessibility and equity analysis, service reliability and resilience to weather, and complement GTFS-based city collections such as the 25-city public transport networks catalogued here.
